items.text: USolomoni wasebuthanisa eJerusalema abadala bakoIsrayeli lazo zonke izinduna zezizwe eziyizikhulu zezindlu zabakoIsrayeli, ukuba bakhuphe umtshokotsho
seNkosi emzini kaDavida othiwa yiZiyone.
Bonke abantu bakoIsrayeli babuthana enkosini uSolomoni ngesikhathi somkhosi enyangeni kaEthanimi eyinyanga yesikhombisa.
Beza bonke abadala bakoIsrayeli, abapristi bawuthwala umtshokotsho wesivumelwano,
bawuletha ethempelini kanye lethente lokuhlangana, lazo zonke izitsha ezingcwele ezazisethenteni; abapristi lamaLevi bazithwala.
Inkosi uSolomoni lalo lonke ibandla lakoIsrayeli elalibuthene babephambi komtshokotsho benikela imihlatshelo yezimvu lezinkabi ezingelakubalwa ubunengi bazo.
Abapristi basebewungenisa umtshokotsho wesivumelwano seNkosi endaweni yawo endlwaneni engaphakathi kwendlu, eyindawo engcwele kakhulu, bawubeka ngaphansi kwempiko
Ngoba
elulela impiko zawo phezu kwendawo yomtshokotsho, awembesa umtshokotsho lezigodo zawo.
Izigodo zazinde kakhulu, izihloko zazo zikhanya ngasendaweni engcwele engaphambi kwendlu engaphakathi, kodwa zingabonakali ngaphandle; zikhona lapho kuze kube lamhla.
Kwakungelalutho emtshokotshweni, kuphela amatshe amabili uMose awafaka khona eHorebe lapho iNkosi yenza khona isivumelwano labakoIsrayeli ekuphumeni kwabo eGibithe.
Dute 10:5
Basebephumake abapristi endaweni engcwele lokhu iyezi laseligcwele ethempelini;
ngakho babengaselakukhonza ngenxa yalo, ngoba inkazimulo yeNkosi yagcwala endlini yayo.
USolomoni wasesithi:
Inkosi uSolomoni yasiphenduka, yalibusisa lonke ibandla lakoIsrayeli elalimi.
Yathi: Kayibongwe iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, egcwalise ngesandla sayo lokho eyakuthembisa kubaba uDavida isithi:

Kusukela ekubakhupheni kwami abakoIsrayeli eGibithe kangikhethanga muzi ezizweni zonke zakoIsrayeli ukwakhela khona indlu yami, ukuba ibizo lami lidunyiselwe khona, kodwa ngakhetha uDavida ukuphatha abantu bami uIsrayeli.
Kwakuyisifiso sikababa uDavida ukwakhela iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, indlu.
Kodwa iNkosi yathi kubaba uDavida: Njengoba bekuyisifiso sakho ukungakhela indlu, wenze kuhle ngokufisa lokho;
kodwake kawuyikuyakha indlu wena, indodana ozayizala yiyo ezakungakhela indlu.
INkosi isigcwalisile isithembiso eyasenzayo, ngoba mina ngingenile esikhundleni sikababa uDavida, ngiyabusa uIsrayeli, sengiyakhele iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, indlu.
Ngawulungisela khona indawo umtshokotsho
seNkosi eyasenza labokhokho bethu ekubakhupheni kwayo eGibithe.
USolomoni wasesima phambi kwealtare leNkosi phambi kwalo lonke ibandla lakoIsrayeli, waphakamisela izandla zakhe phezulu

wathi: Nkosi, Nkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, kakho uNkulunkulu ofana lawe ezulwini phezulu lasemhlabeni phansi ogcina isivumelwano utshengisa uthando olungapheliyo ezincekwini zakho ezihamba phambi kwakho ngobuqotho.
Usigcinile isithembiso owasenza kubaba uDavida; lokho owakuthembisayo lamhla ukugcwalisile ngokupheleleyo.

Ngakhoke, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, gcina isithembiso owasenza lenceku yakho uDavida ubaba usithi: Kawuyikuswela muntu ozabusa abakoIsrayeli uba amadodana akho enanzelela ukuhamba kwawo phambi kwami njengawe.
1 Kho 2:4
Nkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, kaligcwaliseke ilizwi lakho owalikhuluma kuDavida ubaba, inceku yakho.
Kambe uNkulunkulu uzahlala yini emhlabeni? Khangela, iphezulu, lezulu eliphezulu kakhulu kakukulingananga; pho, lindlu engiyakhileyo ingayini kuwe na?
2 Lan 2:6
Kodwake akuzwe umkhuleko wenceku yakho kanye lokucela kwayo, Nkosi Nkulunkulu wami, ulalele ukukhala lokukhuleka kwenceku yakho ekwenzayo phambi kwakho lamuhla.
Ebusuku lemini amehlo akho kawakhangele lindlu, indawo owatsho ngayo ukuthi: Ibizo lami lizakudunyiswa lapho; ukuze uwuzwe umkhuleko wenceku yakho ikhangele kulindawo.
Dute 12:11
Akulalele ukucela kwenceku yakho lokwabantu bakho uIsrayeli lapho bekhuleka bekhangele kulindawo; yebo, uzwe wena, usezulwini endaweni yakho yokuhlala; lapho usizwa, uthethelele.
Uba umuntu esona umakhelwana wakhe, afungiswe, enze isifungo sakhe phambi kwealtare lakho kulindlu,
akuzwe wena usezulwini, wahlulele inceku zakho, uyilahle elecala, wehlisele izenzo zayo phezu kwayo, uyekele elungileyo, uyinike umvuzo ofanele ukulunga kwayo.
Lapho abantu bakho bakoIsrayeli besahlulwa yizitha zabo ngoba bonile kuwe, uba bephenduka, balivume ibizo lakho, bakhuleke kuwe bekuncenga kulindlu,
akuzwe wena usezulwini, uthethelele isono sabantu bakho uIsrayeli, ubabuyise futhi elizweni owalinika okhokho babo.
Lapho iphezulu livaliwe, kungelazulu ngoba bonile kuwe, uba bekhuleka bekhangele kulindawo belivuma ibizo lakho, baphenduke esonweni sabo nxa ubatshaya,
akuzwe wena usezulwini, uthethelele izono zenceku yakho lezabantu bakho uIsrayeli, ubafundise indlela elungileyo abangahamba ngayo, unise izulu elizweni lakho owabanika lona libe ngelabo.
Uba kukhona indlala elizweni lomkhuhlane lokutshisa lengumane lesikhongwane lemihogoyi, uba izitha zabo zivimbezele imizi yabo, loba behlutshwa yikuphi ukufa lomkhuhlane,
nxa bonke abantu bakho uIsrayeli, loba oyedwa wabo ekhuleka, ecela, evuswa yinhlupheko losizi, ephakamisela izandla zakhe kulindlu,
akuzwe wena usezulwini, endaweni yakho yokuhlala, umthethelele, umnike okufanele izenzo zakhe, wena owaziyo inhliziyo yakhe — ngoba nguwe wedwa owaziyo inhliziyo zabantu —
ukuba bakwesabe insuku zonke zokuphila kwabo elizweni owalinika okhokho bethu.
Futhi owezizweni ongesuye wasebantwini bakho uIsrayeli evela elizweni elikhatshana ngenxa yebizo lakho
— ngoba bazakuzwa ngebizo lakho elikhulu langesandla sakho esilamandla langengalo yakho elamandla — eze ukukhuleka akhangele kulindlu,

akuzwe wena usezulwini, endaweni yakho yokuhlala, umenzele konke akucelayo, ukuze abantu bonke emhlabeni bazi ibizo lakho, bakwesabe, njengabantu bakho bakoIsrayeli, ukuba bazi ukuthi lindlu engiyakhileyo iyindawo lapho ibizo lakho lidunyiselwa khona.
Uba abantu bakho bephuma impi ukulwa lezitha zabo loba kungaphi lapho obesa khona, bekhuleke eNkosini bekhangele ngakulo umuzi owukhethileyo langasendlini engikwakhele yona.
akuzwe wena usezulwini ukukhuleka lokuncenga kwabo, ubamele.
Uba besona kuwe, ngoba kakulamuntu ongoniyo, ubusubathukuthelela, ubanikele esitheni, ukuze bathunjelwe elizweni lezitha zabo, khatshana ingabe eduze,
baphenduke elizweni abathunjelwe kilo, bakhuleke kuwe elizweni lelo bathi: Sonile, senza okungalunganga lokubi;

baphenduke ngengqondo zabo zonke langenhliziyo zabo zonke elizweni lezitha zabo ezibathumbileyo, bakhuleke bekhangele ngaselizweni labo owalinika okhokho babo, lasemzini owawukhethayo, lasendlini engikwakhele yona,
akuzwe wena umkhuleko wabo lokucela kwabo usezulwini, endaweni yakho yokuhlala, ubamele.
Thethelela abantu bakho izono zabo leziphambeko zabo zonke kuwe, wenze izitha zabo ezibathumbileyo zibe lesihawu kibo,
ngoba bayisizwe sakho, abantu bakho owabakhupha eGibithe, esithandweni sokuncibilikisa insimbi.
Unanzelele ukucela kwenceku yakho lokucela kwabantu bakho uIsrayeli, ubalalele ekukhulekeni kwabo.
Ngoba wabehlukanisa kuzo zonke izizwe zomhlaba baba ngabakho, njengokutsho kwakho ngoMose, inceku yakho, ekukhupheni kwakho okhokho bethu elizweni laseGibithe, wena Nkosi Nkulunkulu.
Kwathi eseqedile uSolomoni konke ukukhuleka lokucela kwakhe eNkosini, wasukuma ngaphambi kwealtare leNkosi lapho ayeguqe khona ephakamisele izandla zakhe phezulu.
Wema wabusisa lonke ibandla lakoIsrayeli ngelizwi elikhulu esithi:
Kayibongwe iNkosi enike abantu bayo uIsrayeli ukuphumula njengokuthembisa kwayo konke; kakuphuthanga lelilodwa ilizwi laso sonke isithembiso sayo esihle eyasikhuluma ngenceku yayo uMose.
Dute 12:10
INkosi uNkulunkulu wethu ibe lathi njengalokhu yayilabokhokho bethu, ingasitshiyi ingasilahli,
ukuze idonsele inhliziyo zethu kuyo, ukuba sihambe ngazo zonke indlela zayo, sigcine imilayo yayo lezimiso zayo lemithetho yayo eyayinika okhokho bethu.
Kakuthi amazwi okukhuleka kwami phambi kweNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu abe seduze layo emini lebusuku, imele inceku yayo labantu bayo uIsrayeli, njengokudingekayo insuku ngensuku,
ukuze izizwe zonke zomhlaba zazi ukuba iNkosi inguNkulunkulu, lokuba kakho omunye.
Inhliziyo zenu kazibe seNkosini uNkulunkulu wethu ngokupheleleyo, lihambe ngezimiso zayo, ligcine imilayo yayo njengalamhlanje.
USolomoni laye wonke uIsrayeli banikela imihlatshelo phambi kweNkosi.

USolomoni wanikela kube yiminikelo yokuthula eNkosini inkabi ezizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili lambili, lezimvu ezizinkulungwane ezilikhulu lamatshumi amabili. Inkosi labo bonke abakoIsrayeli bayahlukanisela iNkosi uNkulunkulu indlu.

Ngalona lolosuku uSolomoni wayahlukanisela iNkosi indawo ephakathi kweguma elalingaphambi kwethempeli, ngoba lapho wanikela iminikelo yokutshiswa leminikelo yempuphu, lamahwahwa eminikelo yokuthula, ngoba ialtare lethusi elaliphambi kweNkosi lalilincinyane kakhulu ukutshisela kulo umnikelo wokutshiswa lomnikelo wempuphu lamahwahwa eminikelo yokuthula.
Ngalesosikhathi uSolomoni labo bonke abakoIsrayeli ababelixuku elikhulu, ababevela ekuyeni ngaseHamathi kusiya esifuleni saseGibithe benza umkhosi phambi kweNkosi uNkulunkulu insuku eziyisikhombisa.

Ngosuku lwesificaminwembili uSolomoni wabadabulela abantu; bambonga, baya emizini yabo bethokoza bejabula enhliziyweni ngakho konke okuhle iNkosi uNkulunkulu eyayikwenzele uDavida inceku yayo loIsrayeli abantu bayo.
